Hi Sophie —

Following up with technical details you asked for. I'm pasting high-level answers here and attaching a short redacted SOC 2 summary for your team to review. Happy to expand any item in the VSQ.

SOC 2 / compliance:
- Current status: Redwood has an internal SOC 2 program. We completed SOC 2 Type I in Nov 2025 and have an external Type II audit engagement in process with an expected report date of 2026-08-10.
- Interim evidence: attaching SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf (contains scope, controls tested to-date, and redacted exceptions).
- We can discuss compensating controls if you need production evidence before the Type II completion.

HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment and contractual BAA. For hosted/demo/prod, we can execute a BAA and offer dedicated/private options with customer-managed keys. Let's have your legal/procurement team share BAA requirements; we have a standard template.

Telemetry / cookies / docs site:
- Console telemetry: collects usage metrics (API call counts, latency, error rates), resource IDs, and non-PII metadata (organization id, request metadata). By default we do not capture customer prompt/response content in aggregated telemetry; raw request payloads are retained only as part of customer logs subject to your data retention settings and access controls.
- Cookies & trackers: Docs site uses Google Analytics (ga) for docs usage and a session cookie for docs preferences. Console uses secure session cookies (HTTPOnly) and a short-lived analytics beacon for product telemetry. We do not embed advertising trackers.
- Retention: Default telemetry retention 90 days; logs for support/eval escalations can be retained longer by request; all retention windows are configurable for Private/Dedicated customers.

Next steps I can take now:
- Fill out the GreenTree-VSQ first tab with technical answers (will return in 2 business days).
- Share SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf now (attached).
- Schedule a 30-min technical/privacy call — propose Mon 7/20 10:00am PT.

Attachments: SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf
